scene.title: Sum of interior angles of a hexagon
scene.summary: A regular hexagon’s six interior angles each measure 120°, so their sum is 720°.

beats.title: Draw a hexagon
beats.narration: A regular hexagon is drawn with its six vertices labeled.

beats.title: Mark each interior angle
beats.narration: Each interior angle of a regular hexagon measures 120 degrees.

beats.title: Show the calculation
beats.narration: Using (n‑2)·180°, with n=6 gives a sum of 720 degrees.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: All six interior angles add up to 720°, no matter the hexagon’s shape.
